content: When a potential buyer begins to identify their next car-purchase they begin with identifying their needs. These needs often come in the form of an abstract situation, for instance, “I need a car that goes really fast”. This could mean that they need a car with a V8 engine type or a car that has 500 horsepower, but the buyer does not know that, all they know is that they need a “fast” car.
